synopsis:
The CH Postal Company has just received a request to transcribe a love letter from Irma Felice, a famous opera singer. Accepting the task, Violet Evergarden visits Irma to write her letter. However, not only does Irma provide little information, she asks Violet to write based on her own feelings. Despite Violet's numerous attempts, Irma finds every version of the letter inadequate.

Violet consults her colleagues, and they help her out by writing love letters of their own. Yet even those are rejected by the opera singer. As a last resort, Violet asks Irma for her true thoughts and feelings, hoping to find the missing puzzle piece. Will the Auto Memory Doll be able to translate Irma's emotions into words?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: "I Love You" and Auto Memoir Dolls
episodes_data.description: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert`s relatives, he offers her a job.

episodes_data.title: Not Coming Back
episodes_data.description: Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.

episodes_data.title: May You Be an Exemplary Auto Memoir Doll
episodes_data.description: Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.

episodes_data.title: Don't Be a Tool, Become Someone That Matches with Their Name
episodes_data.description: When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris`s birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.

episodes_data.title: You Write Letters That Bring People Together?
episodes_data.description: Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness’s behalf.

episodes_data.title: Under Some Starry Sky
episodes_data.description: Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.
A playwright with writer`s block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.

episodes_data.title: Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.

episodes_data.title: Violet Evergarden
episodes_data.description: Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.

episodes_data.title: A Loved One Will Always Watch Over You
episodes_data.description: Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write a letter for a gravely ill war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents Violet`s presence.

episodes_data.title: I Don't Want Anybody Else to Die
episodes_data.description: Against Hodgins` wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.

episodes_data.title: Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The Major`s older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace. Violet intercepts his train.

episodes_data.title: The Auto Memory Doll and "I Love You"
episodes_data.description: The signing ceremony concludes, officially bringing an end to the war. While writing letters for an air show, Violet composes a letter to the Major.

specials_data.title: "The Day You Understand "I Love You" Will Surely Come."
specials_data.description: Violet accepts an unusual request from a very demanding opera singer: Ilma wants her to write a love letter she can use for lyrics in an aria.

specials_data.title: Violet Evergarden Recollections
specials_data.description: An emotionally scarred former child soldier becomes a letter writer in this condensed recap.
